title: 2100. Find Good Days to Rob the Bank

examples.explanation: On day 2, we have security[0] >= security[1] >= security[2] <= security[3] <= security[4]. On day 3, we have security[1] >= security[2] >= security[3] <= security[4] <= security[5]. No other days satisfy this condition, so days 2 and 3 are the only good days to rob the bank.
Since time equals 0, every day is a good day to rob the bank, so return every day.
No day has 2 days before it that have a non-increasing number of guards. Thus, no day is a good day to rob the bank, so return an empty list.
